anchor_papers.strategy: RANDOM-MATURITY ARBITRAGE: open the position when the futures-spot spread exceeds the theoretical bound under a given trading-cost tier, and close it when the spread returns to its theoretical relationship under no trading costs. anchor_papers.funding_treatment: core mechanism — funding paid every eight hours and approximately equal to the average futures-spot spread over the preceding eight hours
anchor_papers.primary_result: crypto deviations larger than in currency markets, comove across currencies, and diminish over time. anchor_papers.statistical_test: Newey-West adjusted p-values (lag 120 days) on mean rho and |rho|
anchor_papers.stated_caveat: the paper states that funding-rate arbitrage 'is not risk-free even disregarding margin requirements and trading costs, simply because there is no predetermined expiration date when the trade would be unwound at a profit'

anchor_papers.primary_result: price shows critical-slowing-down in 5 of 7 events but not in the 2 sudden-news shocks; taker order-flow variance compression is common to all events and passes a 300-onset placebo test, but is a population-level indicator rather than a per-event warning

candidates.ango_reproducible_scope: Blocked. Ango's liquidation data path is unavailable: Binance Vision liquidationSnapshot returned 404 on 2026-08-16 (backlog I7) and OKX liquidation ingestion is not implemented.
candidates.independent_confirmation_window: not applicable while the data is blocked
operational_risks: a 7-event sample cannot support a trading rule regardless of statistics

score_rationale.mechanism_clarity: Forced deleveraging is a real mechanism, but the paper's own conclusion is that warnings are event-heterogeneous.
score_rationale.data_availability: Liquidation data is blocked for ango (backlog I7).
score_rationale.cost_execution_realism: No tradable execution design is offered.
score_rationale.independent_confirmation: Ango could add 2026 events, but N would still be tiny.
score_rationale.reimplementability: Method is simple; the events are not obtainable.
score_rationale.evidence_quality: Recent preprint with a genuine placebo test, credited accordingly.

external_knowledge_contamination.principle: Selecting a hypothesis because of a paper's reported result contaminates that paper's sample period for ango, even though ango never looked at the price data.
external_knowledge_contamination.ango_sealed_split: final_oos = ts >= 2026-01-01T00:00Z (mce.backtest.splits.FINAL_OOS_START) — NOT opened by this task

knowledge_acquired_during_this_review.fact: crypto DATED-FUTURES carry averaged about 7% p.a. across exchanges and can spike above 40% p.a., with strong time variation, driven by leveraged retail demand and constrained arbitrage capital
knowledge_acquired_during_this_review.note: period corrected by X2; instrument corrected by X1 (dated futures, not perpetuals)

knowledge_acquired_during_this_review.fact: perpetual deviations from no-arbitrage prices are larger than in currency markets, comove, and diminish over time

A2's random-maturity arbitrage on BITCOIN perpetual futures reports a Sharpe ratio of 1.8 under high trading costs typical of retail investors, and up to 3.5 for highly-active market makers, on Binance
knowledge_acquired_during_this_review.note: This is the single most contaminating number for P8-C1: ango now knows the anchor paper's reported risk-adjusted magnitude before running anything. It must NOT be used to set any threshold.

knowledge_acquired_during_this_review.fact: hourly BTC ML sign strategies fail at 10 bps; a cost-aware filter restores profitability in selected configurations but does not significantly beat buy-and-hold
in the crypto cross-section, two to three factors eliminate all significant portfolio alphas; liquidity dominates
a constrained LLM agent's ridge-combined portfolio reported 44.55% annualized and Sharpe 1.55 after 5 bps one-way
for BTC, L2 liquidity state dominates and order flow adds only limited incremental value
claimed Hyperliquid single-venue carry roughly 17.9% (2024) and 3.6% (2025); cross-venue spread 14.7% (2024) and 4.6% (2025)
knowledge_acquired_during_this_review.note: search snippets only; must not be used as design evidence
